steps.description: After completing the **Atman** events, talk to **Roger** in the **Nemeton Monastery**; he'll notice the **Erotic Book** you have, and will give you the **Pulse Tract** in exchange for it!

text.text: You must have done the following to trigger this last series of events:

items.text: Defeated the **Orb Chaos**/**Cherubim**/**Seraphim** in the bonus dungeons.
Played the **Lottery** with **every** member up until now.
Been sent to **Neameeto** at least once.
Obtained **all 3** Fusions in each Fusion class, **and** **Amon** for **Yuri**.

steps.description:
1. Talk to **Roger** again, and he'll want help for an experiment.
2. The help? The dreaded **Spin Ring** 10! Yes, 30 hits on the **Judgment Ring**!
3. Personally, I was able to get it in two tries (the first time I missed the very last one), but keep at it, and you'll eventually hit them all.
4. Try your best not to break your TV, your controller, your PS2, **anything**.
5. Stay calm and focused, and you should do it.
6. By completing it, you'll receive **Yuri**'s best weapon, the **Nightbird Claw**.

1. Next, **save your game**!
2. Then talk to **Roger** again, and he'll ask if you wish to go to **Neameeto**.

choices.option: 1. Wait, I need to use the bathroom!

steps.description:
- Choose 1, and as long as you have played the **Lottery** with **all 15** of the previous members, you'll find out that **Roger** is **Lottery Member** No. 00, the Chairman!
- Nothing strange about the ring here, just really small hit areas!
- **Make sure to win both the Cotton Underpants and Comet Mask before continuing on.**
- The **Cotton Underpants** is an accessory for **Alice** that increases her physical defense AND cuts normal attack damage in half (and change the color of her panties from pink to white!).
- The **Comet Mask** increases P-Def, S-Def, and P-Avd when equipped, and can't be obtained anywhere else.
- If you don't win what you want, reload your last save and try again.

steps.description:
- Now that we've met all the **Lottery Members**, feel free to waste your remaining tickets on whichever **Lottery Members** you like!
- I recommend **Seals of the Soul** for your lower SP party members, mainly **Alice**.
- As well as some of the other **Seals**, and some of the ultimate recovery items like the **Talisman of Power**, which revives an ally completely when used.

description.text: If for some reason **Roger** doesn't show up as being the next **Lottery Member**, then you missed someone.

Here are the locations of all of the **Lottery Members** in the game; you can't do anything about the ones in China, but you can check with all of the ones here in Europe to make sure you didn't miss any:

items.text: **Lottery Member** No. #05: **London, Old Castle Street** (**Drunken Orro**)
If you already won his red prize, he will no longer appear.
You also must have completed the **Water Gravestone** side quest and acted as a preacher to have No. 02 appear to begin with.

steps.description: Now that we're finished with the **Lottery**, we need to move on to the very last side quest of them all: the **Seraphic Radiance**.
Examine the **Pulse Tract** that you received from **Roger**; it depicts a new path through the **Ancient Ruins**, so that's where we're headed.

description.text: **Ancient Ruins**: enter the maze, then take the following paths:

steps.description:
- After you reach the very last area, be back at the beginning.
- Descend the stairs here and walk up to the altar; you'll find a chest containing the **Stone of Rebirth**.
- Make your way out of the **Ancient Ruins** and back onto the **World Map**.
**Save your game** and enter the **Graveyard** for the last time.

text.text: The next battle is **extremely** difficult, as it will be with **Yuri** alone. I recommend doing the following things before attempting to fight:

items.text: Put both the **Brsrkr Earrings** and the **Seven-Eyed Mask** (or **Comet Mask**) on him to boost his HP and defense, respectively.
Equip the **Mind's Eye** on him, unless you're still taking more damage in two rounds that you can't heal on.
If that's the case, equip a **Voodoo Doll**; it'll boost your S-Def a bit more AND revive **Yuri** once if he dies.
Buy some **Third Keys** to help speed the battle along. (optional)

steps.description:
1. Go through the northern gate, then go as far as you can north to examine the sunset.
2. Attempt to leave, and you'll encounter **Ben Hyuga**.
3. After some discussion about him and the **Seraphic Radiance**, you'll have to face him in an attempt to conquer and capture the god.

items.text: First off is **Ben**; he'll use physical attacks, but once you do about 2000 HP worth of damage, he will then fuse into the **Seraphic Radiance**!
**Malcto** will hit **Yuri** for major damage while also healing itself!
That's its only special attack; the only other thing it does is its attack, and it hits **hard**!
If you're not in the back row, you better shift there immediately.
As long as you're in the back row, you should be able to attack two, possibly three times in a row before you will have to heal with a **Thera Root** or, preferably, a **Thera Extract**.
Fuse into **Amon**, or if you need some spare SP, then **Lobo** (since he has the 2nd highest P-Def at this point, as well as the same P-Atk as **Amon**).
All you'll be doing is physically attacking a round or two, then healing the next.
Yep, that's it... pretty boring actually, but any other route will likely get you killed.
If you find yourself in trouble, try using **Third Keys** to help dish out damage when you have an opportunity to.
If you're **still** having trouble with him, then you'll just have to level up and try again.

steps.description:
- Once he's defeated, you'll earn **Yuri**'s final fusion, the **Seraphic Radiance**.
- Watch the cut-scene here, and when you regain control, return to the tree where you fought **Ben**.
- Open a chest behind the tree, and you'll find **Yuri**'s best armor, his **Father's Coat**.
That's it for all the side quests. Let's go to **[W-2-17] Neameeto** and end this.
